description: This file defines a logging system with classes for Logger and NoopLogger, functions for creating log level factories, and re-exports. It manages log levels, reporting, and performance measurement within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Implements ILogger, provides logging methods, scope creation, and performance measurement.

classes.name: NoopLogger
classes.description: A no-operation logger that implements ILogger with empty methods.

methods.name: scope
methods.description: Creates a new Logger instance with a specified scope.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error with error details.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error with error details.

methods.name: measure
methods.description: Marks performance timing for a given tag and logs duration.

methods.name: replaceWith
methods.description: Replaces the current logger's methods with another ILogger instance.
